capabilities: Runs native table workflows and table coloring
Copies content as an image and creates short links
disambiguation: Not a general Obsidian performance or appearance upgrade; it adds a floating toolbar, a template library, table styling and small utilities.
extras: Releases ship only main.js, manifest.json and styles.css, with no notes, templates, settings, caches, backups, absolute paths or credentials. Enhanced tables only work in the background when the experimental OneNote high-fidelity paste option is on.
problem: People arriving from Feishu, WeCom, Notion or OneNote have to hunt through Obsidian for everyday actions such as inserting templates, styling tables and handling attachments.

relations.evidence: 需同时安装本仓库 companion-plugins 中的 markdown-table-enhancer
optional integrations such as Claudian and video timeline preview

summary: Toolkit for people moving from Feishu, WeCom, Notion or OneNote to Obsidian: floating toolbar, template library, table tools and small utilities.
